name: Fotoğraf Gezisi
scene: A vintage travel camera with a large concentric lens and looping strap stands against flowing landscape and sky bands.
notes: Target 36–46 panes. Generated with clai image using the old camera artwork as subject reference and vitray_fox / vitray_lighthouse as style references; inspected and regenerated once to simplify subdivisions and enforce separate colour pairs. Camera and strap use amber/burgundy; background uses turquoise/deep blue. Remaining doubts: generated fills retain subtle shading; exterior is transparent rather than opaque white and must be interpreted on white. Some same-colour neighbouring panes remain, particularly the camera body and lower lens rim; they may merge during tracing. Small strap attachment pieces and close junctions require review in tracing. Pane count and T-junction compliance are not computationally certified. Design-stage output only.
